facts.fact: Clement 与 Ysabel 十岁那年发生了一次日全食，那是两人一同进入 Academie 的八年前
facts.anchor: There was a complete solar eclipse when Clement and Ysabel were ten years old.

facts.fact: 宪兵因举报 Savoye 家把孩子整天关在家里、不许上学而多次上门；Niesken Savoye 先谎称四个年幼孩子生病、长女 Agnes 已满十八岁，后又向宪兵扔了一个空瓶（未击中），宪兵没收了家中所有蜡烛
facts.anchor: Niesken threw an empty bottle at the gendarmes—missing, luckily

facts.fact: 十三年来 Ysabel 一直是挡在 Clement 与被注目之间的月亮；她死后，Clement 重新暴露在众人的注视下
facts.anchor: had been the moon that stood between Clement and the dreadful light of being noticed

facts.fact: Clement 搜遍 Ysabel 的图书馆书桌和宿舍，那本黄色封面的旧笔记本始终不见踪影
facts.anchor: no sign anywhere of the battered, yellow-covered notebook that Clement was searching for.

facts.fact: 术师 Decroy 放 Clement 进入二号考场的观察廊；他转述听来的说法「她是跳下去而非参加考试」，Clement 当场反驳说她是被杀的
facts.anchor: “She didn’t,” Clement said. They couldn’t keep it in. “She was killed.”

facts.fact: Clement 在 Ysabel 的房间里把手指伸进烛火，直到灼痛才抽回，随后治好新起的水泡，却刻意保留上臂旧日的仪式伤疤
facts.anchor: Clement passed their fingers through the flame, then slower, and slower.

facts.fact: Ysabel 的母亲 Tiphaine 认为 Clement 把责任推到别处更容易，反问谁会想杀 Ysabel，并说疗愈师常见的可怕意外和过度自我施压更可信
facts.anchor: But who would ever want to kill Ysabel?

facts.fact: Clement 想当着 Ysabel 的母亲 Adala 与 Tiphaine 的面发誓要找出凶手、将其绳之以法，但最终只在沉默中许下承诺
facts.anchor: They made the promise in silence instead.
